body.title: A client change after sign-off
body.briefing: The client wants a change after sign-off. Maya leads the engagement, Jordan knows the delivery work, and Sam supports People and HR processes. Clarify the need, state the impact, and agree how the change is handled.

labels.CL-G1: Confirm the real need behind the change
labels.CL-G2: State the impact on the current sprint plan
labels.CL-G3: Agree how the change is handled and recap it
labels.CL-R1: Offer a limited option that protects this week
labels.CL-R2: Propose deferring the change to a later cycle
labels.CL-R3: Confirm who handles the next step

body.content: The client's own customer demo is on day 2, which is why the change cannot wait for the next sprint.
body.unlock_question: What deadline is the client actually working to?

body.content: With Jordan's pairing help, the change takes about two days and displaces planned test work; it touches one module.
body.unlock_question: How large is the change, and what would it displace?

body.content: The signed paperwork permits one scope revision if it is documented before the demo slot.
body.unlock_question: What does the agreement allow for late changes?

body.content: The customer can absorb the revision in a later cycle if a short workaround covers the earlier customer event.
body.unlock_question: Is there a path that keeps both dates?

body.persona: Client-facing lead who turns requests into commitments and dislikes surprises.
body.public_context: Maya owns the client relationship and the engagement timeline.
body.motivation: Maya wants the client to hear one clear answer rather than three versions.

body.persona: Estimates honestly and asks what will be displaced before adding work.
body.public_context: Jordan builds the deliverable and knows the implementation detail.
body.motivation: Jordan wants estimates to include whatever gets displaced.

body.persona: Supports fair workload conversations and keeps engagement approvals clear.
body.public_context: Sam supports the team's people processes and maintains engagement records.
body.motivation: Sam wants people to understand their responsibilities and use a clear approval process.
